description: This file defines a REST API controller for managing vulnerability categories in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, and deleting vulnerability categories, with auditing integrated.

classes.name: VulnerabilitiesCategoriesController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core API controller for handling CRUD operations related to vulnerability categories, including creation, listing, and deletion.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add a new vulnerability category, logs creation, and returns the created resource.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of vulnerability categories, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove a vulnerability category by ID, with auditing.
